message.content:
Let \(\mathbf{P}\) be the orthogonal projection onto the line spanned by \(\mathbf{v}\).

Any vector \(\mathbf{x}\) can be decomposed as
\[
\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{P}\mathbf{x} + (\mathbf{I}-\mathbf{P})\mathbf{x},
\]
where \(\mathbf{P}\mathbf{x}\) is parallel to \(\mathbf{v}\), and \((\mathbf{I}-\mathbf{P})\mathbf{x}\) is perpendicular to \(\mathbf{v}\).

Reflecting over the line spanned by \(\mathbf{v}\) keeps the parallel component the same and negates the perpendicular component:
\[
\mathbf{R}\mathbf{x}
= \mathbf{P}\mathbf{x} - (\mathbf{I}-\mathbf{P})\mathbf{x}
= 2\mathbf{P}\mathbf{x} - \mathbf{I}\mathbf{x}.
\]
Thus,
\[
\mathbf{R} = 2\mathbf{P} - \mathbf{I}.
\]
So \(a=2\) and \(b=-1\).

The answer is \((2,-1)\).
